ADMISSION MECHANICS — Kazakhstani (SDU) bachelor → German & French Masters, Fall 2027 intake. Applicant: Timofey Demidov, Russian citizen resident in Kazakhstan, BA International Relations (English-medium), SDU University Kaskelen, 240 ECTS expected June 2027, grand average 79.53% (pass 50%), GPA 2.83/4.0.

=====================================================
A. GERMANY
=====================================================

1. DEGREE RECOGNITION (anabin)
- A 4-year Kazakhstani bachelor (240 ECTS-equivalent) from a state-accredited university normally gives DIRECT master admission in Germany (anabin equivalence class "entspricht/gleichwertig" for Kazakh bachelor degrees). Kazakh universities with national accreditation are generally listed H+.
- SDU's individual entry could NOT be confirmed remotely (anabin.kmk.org is a Java portal that blocks automated fetch). ACTION: check anabin manually — Institutionen > Kasachstan > search "Suleyman Demirel" / "Sulejman Demirel" (transliteration varies). If listed H+ → fine. If not listed or H+/-, uni-assist's VPD assessment settles it in practice — this is exactly what VPD is for, so the VPD route (below) de-risks this entirely.

2. APS — VERIFIED: NOT REQUIRED FOR KAZAKHSTAN (status July 2026)
- The premise "APS Kasachstan became mandatory" is NOT confirmed by any official source. APS (Akademische Prüfstelle) offices exist only for China (2001), Vietnam (2007), India (since Nov 2022; also covers Pakistan/Bangladesh degrees per some sources), plus a Mongolia procedure. Kazakhstan appears in NO official APS country list, and the German missions in Kazakhstan (Embassy Astana / Consulate General Almaty) list no APS step for student visas.
- Caveat 1: nothing found announcing a future APS Kasachstan either — re-verify on kasachstan.diplo.de ~Sept 2026 before the application season, since APS rollouts (India 2022) came with ~8–16 week processing times and would be the critical path if introduced.
- Caveat 2: APS attaches to where the DEGREE was earned, not citizenship — his degree is Kazakh, so even his Russian citizenship does not pull him into any APS regime.

3. UNI-ASSIST / VPD
- Most German unis outsource foreign-credential screening to uni-assist. Two modes: (a) full application via uni-assist; (b) VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) — uni-assist issues a certificate stating his entrance qualification and his grade converted to the German scale; he then applies directly on the university's own portal with the VPD.
- Fees: €75 first program per semester + €30 each additional (some unis cover it). Processing: officially 4–6 weeks, up to 6–8 in peak season (May–July). VPD is typically valid for multiple semesters, so he can request the VPD as early as autumn 2026 with his 6-semester transcript.
- Documents: certified copies of transcript + enrollment certificate (final diploma not yet issued — German unis routinely admit on a provisional transcript of ~140–180 ECTS with conditional admission; final diploma due at enrollment Oct 2027), school certificate (attestat), passport, English cert. Kazakh documents: notarized copies; uni-assist accepts documents in English — SDU issues English transcripts, which avoids sworn-translation cost; Russian/Kazazh documents need certified German or English translation. No apostille needed for uni-assist itself, but some unis require certification (Beglaubigung) by the German mission.
- Since he applies BEFORE graduating: uni-assist evaluates the current transcript; the converted grade will be computed from the 79.53% average.

4. GRADE CONVERSION (Bavarian formula)
- 1 + 3 × (100 − 79.53)/(100 − 50) = 1 + 3 × 20.47/50 = 2.23 German grade = "gut". This clears the typical German master cutoff of 2.5 ("gut oder besser") with room to spare, and is competitive though not stellar where cutoffs are 2.3. Programs demanding 1.x–2.0 ("sehr gut") remain a stretch. Where a program says "above average in political science," his subject grades (Int'l Security 96, IR Theories 90, Russian Politics 92) argue the case in the letter of motivation.
- ECTS subject requirements are the real filter in German poli-sci/IR masters (commonly 60+ ECTS political science/IR, sometimes methods ECTS explicitly — his Research Methods 89 helps). He must map SDU courses to these buckets in a module-description annex.

5. DEADLINES (winter semester 2027/28, start Oct 2027)
- Standard uni-assist window for winter intake: early Dec 2026 / April 2027 → July 15, 2027. BUT selective English-taught IR/security masters set much earlier deadlines: many close Jan 15–Mar 31, 2027 (e.g., Konstanz, Hertie ~Feb 1 scholarship / May 1 final, TU/FU Berlin ~Jan–May). Practical plan: VPD request Oct–Nov 2026, applications Dec 2026–Mar 2027.
- Because uni-assist adds 4–8 weeks BEFORE the deadline counts as met at some unis (documents must be complete/verified by deadline at many), submit to uni-assist ≥6 weeks before each program deadline.

6. FEES & VISA (Germany)
- Public tuition: €0 in most Länder; semester fee ~€150–400. Exception: Baden-Württemberg charges non-EU students €1,500/semester (Konstanz, Freiburg, Tübingen, Heidelberg); Bavaria ALLOWS unis to charge non-EU fees (TUM does; most Bavarian unis still don't). Saxony/Berlin/NRW/Hesse: free.
- Visa: national D-visa at the German mission for his place of LEGAL RESIDENCE — as a Russian citizen legally resident in Kazakhstan (student residence permit) he applies at Consulate General Almaty / Embassy Astana, NOT in Russia. Core requirement: blocked account (Sperrkonto) ~€11,904/yr (2025 figure; expect ~€12,300+ by 2027) or a scholarship letter replacing it. Visa processing Kazakhstan: typically 4–8+ weeks; book appointment immediately upon admission (May–July 2027).
- Funding: DAAD EPOS (for development-related masters, requires 2 yrs work experience — he won't have it), DAAD Helmut-Schmidt (public policy, Kazakhstan not always eligible-country listed — check), Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung / Heinrich-Böll / Friedrich-Ebert foundation scholarships (open to internationals, apply ~summer 2027 or after arrival), Deutschlandstipendium (€300/mo, via the uni after enrollment). Realistic model: free tuition + part-time work rights (140 full days/yr) + foundation scholarship attempt.

=====================================================
B. FRANCE
=====================================================

1. WHICH CAMPUS FRANCE? — RESIDENCE, NOT NATIONALITY
- The Études en France (EEF) procedure is determined by COUNTRY OF RESIDENCE. Kazakhstan IS now on the EEF list (the list grew from 43 to 73 countries; Campus France's own pages confirm "Kazakhstan is one of 73 countries covered by the Études en France procedure"; Russia is also on the list, irrelevant here). → He applies through Campus France KAZAKHSTAN (Espace Campus France Almaty/Astana) on the pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr EEF platform, as a Russian citizen resident in Kazakhstan. He does NOT route through Campus France Russia.
- DAP: NOT needed — DAP is only for 1st-year licence (and architecture). Master applications go via the "hors DAP" (candidat individuel) track of EEF.

2. MON MASTER
- monmaster.gouv.fr explicitly EXCLUDES foreign nationals whose country of residence is covered by Études en France (confirmed on official sources). So for public-university national masters he applies inside the EEF platform (up to 7 choices), not Mon Master. Exception: grandes écoles / Sciences Po / private schools take direct applications on their own portals (Sciences Po's own admissions site, deadlines ~Oct 2026–Jan 2027 for Fall 2027) — EEF is then used only for the visa stage ("Je suis accepté").

3. EEF CALENDAR FOR FALL 2027 (hors-DAP master, pattern from 2026-27 cycle)
- Platform opens ~Oct 2026; hors-DAP master file submission deadline: early December 2026 in most EEF countries (some run to late Jan 2027) — CHECK Campus France Kazakhstan's published calendar in Sept 2026; treat Dec 1–15, 2026 as the working deadline. Campus France interview (entretien pédagogique) Dec 2026–Feb 2027; universities answer by ~Apr 30, 2027; he confirms by ~May 31 (silence = refusal); visa stage Jun–Aug 2027. EEF processing fee payable in KZT locally (amount country-specific, order of €50–100; some scholarship holders exempt).
- Documents: transcripts for 6 semesters (English OK for English-taught programs; French programs want certified French translations), diplomas, passport, CV, motivation letters per choice, language certificate. Applying pre-graduation is normal — attestation de scolarité + transcripts; diploma verified at enrollment.

4. VISA (France)
- After acceptance: EEF "Je suis accepté" → France-Visas long-stay student visa (VLS-TS) via the French consulate/visa center in Kazakhstan (Almaty). Financial proof ~€615/month (~€7,380/yr) — far lower than Germany's blocked account. Processing ~2–4 weeks after EEF is complete.

5. FEES & FUNDING (France)
- Public universities, non-EU "differentiated" master fee: ~€3,879/yr — BUT many universities vote full or partial exemptions for non-EU students (case-by-case; check each program), and Eiffel/France Excellence holders are exempt. Grandes écoles/Sciences Po: €15k–20k/yr but with need-based aid (Sciences Po's sliding scale can cut fees substantially for non-EU low-income; Emile Boutmy scholarship — note it targets non-EU first-time applicants, Russians eligible).
- Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (€1,181/mo + benefits): applicant CANNOT apply himself — the French institution nominates; institutional internal deadlines Sep–Dec 2026, official Eiffel deadline early Jan 2027. So he must contact target programs in autumn 2026 and ask to be put forward. Age/level fine (master, under 25/27 rules OK).
- "Make Our Planet Great Again – Master Kazakhstan" scholarship exists specifically for Kazakhstan-based applicants (2026-27 campaign confirmed on kz.diplomatie.gouv.fr) — climate/planet-adjacent masters; check whether an environmental-security angle qualifies; watch for the 2027-28 campaign ~spring 2027. France Excellence Europa is EU-member-state citizens only — NOT applicable.

=====================================================
C. LANGUAGE CERTIFICATES — TIMING
=====================================================
- IELTS/TOEFL validity 2 years. For Fall 2027 the cert must be VALID AT APPLICATION (Dec 2026–Mar 2027 deadlines) and many unis also want validity at ENROLLMENT (Oct 2027). Optimal window: take IELTS Sept–Nov 2026 → valid through late 2028, covers everything. Do NOT delay past Nov 2026 (EEF deadline early Dec 2026 needs the score in hand; results take ~13 days paper / 3-5 days computer). Target 7.0; most German English-taught IR masters ask IELTS 6.5 (some 7.0/C1), French English-taught ask 6.5.
- Possible waiver: his ENTIRE bachelor is English-medium — many German unis accept a "medium of instruction" letter from SDU instead of IELTS, and some French programs too. Check per program, but get IELTS anyway: it's required by Eiffel-track schools, strengthens weak-GPA files, and removes case-by-case risk.
- French: for English-taught masters no French cert needed (A2-B1 helpful for visa life). For French-taught or bilingual programs: DELF B2 minimum, C1 preferred. TCF/TEF valid 2 years, DELF/DALF valid FOREVER — so if he sits an exam, DELF B2 (session autumn 2026) is the better buy than TCF. With current B1-B2 and his 95/A last French course, DELF B2 by Nov 2026 is realistic; a French-taught master (C1 territory) by Fall 2027 is a stretch — recommend English-taught programs in France, with French as a bonus line in the file.

=====================================================
D. CRITICAL-PATH TIMELINE (working backwards)
=====================================================
- Aug–Sep 2026: shortlist programs; verify SDU on anabin; email programs re: IELTS waiver + Eiffel nomination; book IELTS + DELF B2.
- Sep–Oct 2026: sit IELTS; open EEF file when Campus France Kazakhstan opens (~Oct 1); request uni-assist VPD with 6-semester transcript (fee €75).
- Nov 2026: complete EEF file (7 choices); ask Eiffel nomination; finish motivation letters.
- Dec 1–15, 2026: EEF hors-DAP master deadline (France done). Sciences Po/grandes écoles own portals Dec–Jan.
- Jan–Mar 2027: German applications (early-deadline programs Jan 15–Mar 31); Campus France interview.
- Apr–May 2027: French answers (by Apr 30) + German rolling answers; confirm French choice by May 31.
- May–Jul 2027: Germany late-deadline (Jul 15) backups; open blocked account OR gather French financial proof; book visa appointment in Almaty/Astana immediately on first admission.
- Jun 2027: graduate; send final diploma to fulfill conditional admissions.
- Jul–Aug 2027: visa issued; Sept: travel.
- SINGLE BIGGEST RISKS: (1) missing the early-Dec 2026 EEF deadline because IELTS isn't done — book the test NOW for ≤ Oct 2026; (2) uni-assist peak-season lag for July-deadline programs — submit ≥6 weeks early; (3) re-check APS status for Kazakhstan in Sept 2026 (currently NOT required — verified against APS country lists and German mission pages, but the task premise shows rumors circulate).
